title: 2019 Hoops Premium Stock (Green Prizm) LaMarcus Aldridge #171 San Antonio Spurs
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops Premium Stock trading card features LaMarcus Aldridge of the San Antonio Spurs. The card is a green prizm parallel/variety and has a card number of 171. It is a premium card and a great addition to any sports trading card collection. The card is from the 2019 season and is perfect for basketball fans and collectors.
